title: 第7章【冥婚】消失的尸体
slug: 诡异副本勇敢者的游戏
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“记得。”

顾原一剑刺向朝着自己冲过来的尸体，黑色的脓液从伤口中流出来，散发出一股令人作呕的恶臭。

说罢，张晓朝着顾原靠近几步，随手甩给一张符咒，上面密密麻麻的画着一些顾原根本看不懂的符号。

“贴在额头处，能有三秒的清晰时间，找到客厅，我们冲过去。”张晓说道。

顾原二话没说，将符纸贴在额头上。

贴上的一瞬间，一股清凉从眉心炸开，眼前的浓雾像是被撕开了一道口子，将眼前的场景毫无保留的暴露在自己的面前，而客厅就在自己的后方。

知道了客厅所在的方向，顾原一把抓住张晓，“跟我来。”

话音未落，眼前再次恢复了刚才的雾气，符纸已经变成黑色，明显失效了，但这一次已经知道了方向。

两人没有犹豫，拔腿就跑。

跑了没几步，顾原已经站在了客厅的门口，这里没有雾气，明明只有一掌的距离，却仿佛中间有一层屏障，将雾气遮挡。

雾气中，一道身影正仓皇的四处躲避着，在他的身后有数道身影正在追赶。

“不好。”

顾原仔细一看，这才发现在雾中的人竟然就是张晓，明明刚才他跟着自己的屁股后面，而且距离客厅就只有一步之遥，但是现在却又重新迷失在雾气当中。

怎么办？

是回去救张晓还是去抢尸体？

顾原心中正盘算着，看着雾气中挣扎逃窜的身影，最终顾原还是忍不下心，要是他只是一个剧本杀中的人物，他还有可能放弃，但是这是一个活生生的人，他不能放弃。

“等着，我这就来救你！”顾原大喊一声，但在张晓耳中什么都没有听到，因为吸入了太多雾气，导致现在五感尽失，眼前一片漆黑，什么味道都闻不到。

忽的，一双有温度的手抓住了他，张晓的身子明显一顿，随后另外一只手摩挲上来。

此刻他已经猜到了是顾原来救自己了。

“快走，这里我能应付，你不能停在这里太长时间，否则会和我一样，趁着现在还没有迷失，赶紧出去。”

张晓推搡着顾原，为了防止他的担心自己，接着说道：“我虽然不如我师哥，但是他也没有这么容易要我的命，只有你找到隐藏在这院子中控制阵眼的东西，这阵法自然就破了。”

似乎是担心顾原不知道什么是阵眼，张晓连忙解释：“你看着出现的刚刚合适却又最不合理的东西，很有可能即使控制阵眼的东西。”

“快走吧。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Remember."

Gu Yuan stabbed the corpse rushing toward him with his sword. Black pus flowed out from the wound, emitting a disgusting stench.

After that, Zhang Xiao took a few steps closer to Gu Yuan and threw a spell to him, with some symbols densely painted on it that Gu Yuan couldn't understand at all.

"Put it on your forehead and you will have three seconds of clarity. When you find the living room, we rush there." Zhang Xiao said.

Without saying a word, Gu Yuan put the talisman on his forehead.

The moment he put it on, a cool feeling exploded from the center of his eyebrows. The thick fog in front of him seemed to have been torn open, exposing the scene in front of him without reservation, and the living room was behind him.

Knowing the direction of the living room, Gu Yuan grabbed Zhang Xiao and said, "Follow me."

Before he finished speaking, the mist before his eyes returned again. The talisman had turned black and was obviously ineffective, but this time he knew the direction.

The two of them ran away without hesitation.

After running a few steps, Gu Yuan was already standing at the door of the living room. There was no fog here. It was only a palm away, but it seemed that there was a barrier in the middle to block the fog.

In the mist, a figure was running around hastily, with several figures chasing after him.

"Not good."

Gu Yuan took a closer look and realized that the person in the fog turned out to be Zhang Xiao. He was obviously following behind him just now and was only one step away from the living room, but now he was lost in the fog again.

what to do?

Should he go back to save Zhang Xiao or snatch the body?

Gu Yuan was thinking in his mind, looking at the figure struggling and escaping in the mist. In the end, Gu Yuan still couldn't bear it. If he was just a character killed in the script, he might give up, but this is a living person, and he can't give up.

"Wait, I'm coming to save you!" Gu Yuan shouted, but Zhang Xiao heard nothing. Because he had inhaled too much mist, he had lost all five senses. His eyes were pitch black and he couldn't smell anything.

Suddenly, a pair of warm hands grabbed him. Zhang Xiao's body visibly paused, and then another hand came up to touch him.

At this moment, he had already guessed that it was Gu Yuan who saved him.

"Come on, I can handle it here. You can't stay here for too long, otherwise you will be like me. Get out quickly before you get lost."

Zhang Xiao pushed Gu Yuan, in order to prevent him from worrying about him, and then said: "Although I am not as good as my senior brother, he will not kill me so easily. As long as you find the thing hidden in the courtyard to control the formation, the formation will naturally be broken."

As if he was worried that Gu Yuan didn't know what the formation eye was, Zhang Xiao quickly explained: "Looking at the just right but most unreasonable thing that appears, it is very likely that it can even control the formation eye."

"Let's go."
